paragraphs: They are mentioned many times in the Jerusalem Talmud, and the reference is to the sages of Babylonia.[^1]

notes.text: Rabbanan de-taman is preserved as the collective label The Rabbis There. MANY TIMES in the Jerusalem Talmud and identification with the sages of Babylonia are Hyman's own assertions; this short notice supplies no enumerated passages or individual names. No new whole-work survey, authority binding or historical identification is asserted. The returned Fable PASS remains a historical model judgment, not automatic admission. No named primary passage was supplied or fetched for this review.
